Generated by scripts/source_moves_plan.py move2 at main bb69abd4 (its rule table: 108 modules) plus the placement of the 9 modules it leaves unplaced; processes/ (D198) and core/ (R6') dissolve. Every hazard file of the scan is reviewed with its reason. No identifier changes.
